scoring.zh: 评分 r8.4：按 k 分档计分，不在 0 处截断（N ≥ 0 时 N ÷ P，N < 0 时 N ÷ Σk），整体扣减 max(暂停 0.1, 格式罚 f, ARW 残余 0.1) 只扣一次：最终分 = s − d·|s|；模型失误记 0。
scoring.en: Scoring r8.4: k-tier scoring without the cut at 0 (N / P for N >= 0, N / sum k for N < 0); one overall deduction d = max(pause 0.1, format penalty f, ARW residual 0.1): final = s - d |s|; a model failure scores 0.

selection.zh: 有效实例按开始时刻排序得到 validRank。phase 1：未合并的格取 validRank ≤ 5（firstN）；DeepSeek 合并格（cellPooled，medium 请求并入 high）取全部有效实例。phase 2：Strata 的格取 validRank ≤ 10，其余同 phase 1。phase 3：同 phase 2，另加补充配置 28、29（gpt-6-luna xhigh、max），各格取全部有效实例（mainStatistic 为 true，不截取前 5 个，用户 2026-10-23），只给实例、不进比较，也没有一致性行。inMain 是本文件阶段的结果；主统计多于前 5 个的格另有一致性行（firstN 为 true 的实例）。
selection.en: Valid instances ordered by start give validRank. Phase 1: cells not pooled take validRank <= 5 (firstN); pooled DeepSeek cells (cellPooled, medium requests pooled into high) take every valid instance. Phase 2: Strata cells take validRank <= 10, others as in phase 1. Phase 3: as phase 2, plus the supplement configurations 28 / 29 (gpt-6-luna xhigh / max), every valid instance per cell (mainStatistic true, no first-5 cut, user 2026-10-23), instances only, never in a comparison and without a consistency row. inMain is the result for the phase of this file; a cell whose main statistic holds more than its first 5 also has a consistency row (the instances with firstN true).

sample.zh: 每个配置取 inMain 为 true 的实例（补充配置不参加）；d = 前者均值 − 后者均值。
sample.en: Each configuration contributes its instances with inMain true (supplementary configurations never take part); d = mean(first) - mean(second).

incomplete.zh: 任一侧有未计分实例（score 为 null）时该比较"未计分完"，在 Holm 中按 p = 1 占位；一侧少于 2 个实例时 p 未知，同样按 1 占位。两侧方差都为 0 时 p = 1（均值相等）或 0。
incomplete.en: A comparison with an unscored instance (score null) on either side is incomplete and holds p = 1 in the Holm family; fewer than 2 instances on a side gives no p, also 1. Zero variance on both sides gives p = 1 for equal means, else 0.

decisionRule.zh: Holm p < alpha 时按 d 的符号判"高于 / 低于"，否则"未分出"。
decisionRule.en: Holm p < alpha: higher / lower by the sign of d; otherwise not separated.

caveats.zh: 本工程的报告只给分场景结果，不算综合分、不排名（D7）。本文件只提供实例数据，不含任何权重或综合分。
caveats.en: This project's own reports give per-scenario results only, with no combined score and no ranking (D7). This file provides instance data only and carries no weights or combined scores.

caveats.zh: 分数可为负（评分 r8.4 不在 0 处截断）：N ≥ 0 时分数 = N ÷ P，N < 0 时分数 = N ÷ Σk，正负两侧单位不同；不设下限，可低于 −1。模型失误（没有报告）记 0。
caveats.en: Scores can be negative (scoring r8.4 does not cut at 0): N / P for N >= 0, N / sum k for N < 0, so the two sides have different units; no lower bound (can fall below -1). A model failure (no report) scores 0.

caveats.zh: OpenAI 模型经 ChatGPT 套餐登录运行，只报 token、不报金额；套餐的限速或路由可能与 API 不同。
caveats.en: OpenAI models ran on a ChatGPT plan login: tokens only, no amounts; plan rate limits or routing may differ from the API.

caveats.zh: 场景按 Opus 标定，答案键经 Opus 审计，Opus 同时是唯一的盲裁者，所以 Opus 的位置可能偏高。
caveats.en: Scenarios were calibrated on Opus, answer keys audited by Opus, and Opus is the only blind adjudicator, so Opus's position may be inflated.

caveats.zh: 厂商与 harness 部分绑定：OpenAI 只在 Codex 上，Anthropic 只在 Claude Code 上；只有 Strata 和 DeepSeek 两边都跑。
caveats.en: Vendor and harness are partly bound: OpenAI only on Codex, Anthropic only on Claude Code; only Strata and DeepSeek run on both.

caveats.zh: "强度"含义因厂商而异；DeepSeek 测 low / high / max，Strata 没有 max。DeepSeek medium 请求按端点映射为 high：部分并入 high，部分作补充配置（时限 T 与 high 不同）。
caveats.en: Effort means different things per vendor; DeepSeek runs low / high / max, Strata has no max. DeepSeek medium requests map to high at the endpoint: some are pooled into high, others are a supplementary configuration (their time limit T differs from high).

caveats.zh: 基础提示（启动提示、压缩提示）只给 Strata；所有模型都关闭搜索；guardian、窗口与压缩、时限提醒送达方式各臂不同。
caveats.en: Base prompts (startup, compaction) go to Strata only; search is off for every model; guardian, context window and compaction, and time-limit reminder delivery differ between arms.

caveats.zh: Code Spec 与 Code Standards 的时限按各配置自己的速度算，API 模型的速度含网络和首 token 延迟。
caveats.en: Code Spec and Code Standards limits follow each configuration's own speed; API model speeds include network and first-token latency.

caveats.zh: API 模型分不出输入处理时间：引擎输入速度未知，引擎输出速度按 API 请求时间算，是下限。多个实例的速度按总 token ÷ 总耗时汇总，不取各实例速度的算术平均（用户 2026-10-22）；Codex 上 API 模型的引擎输出按 relay 日志的 output token ÷ 请求秒数计算，请求秒数没有保存、原始日志已删除，所以汇总是近似值（用户 2026-10-22）：Σ`tokens.output` ÷ Σ(`tokens.output` ÷ `speeds.engineOutput`)，即用各实例的速度反推请求秒数，仍是下限。Codex 的 code mode 一次 exec 记 1 次工具调用，gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6-luna 的工具调用数与其他臂不完全同义。
caveats.en: API models give no input-processing time: engine input speed is unknown and engine output speed, timed by API request, is a lower bound. Speeds over several instances pool as total tokens / total seconds, never the arithmetic mean of instance speeds (user 2026-10-22); the engine output of API models on Codex is relay output tokens / request seconds; the request seconds were not kept (the raw logs are deleted), so its pooled value is approximate (user 2026-10-22): sum(tokens.output) / sum(tokens.output / speeds.engineOutput), the request seconds recovered from each instance speed, still a lower bound. A Codex code-mode exec counts as one tool call, so gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6-luna tool-call counts are not fully comparable with other arms.

caveats.zh: null 表示未知或不适用，不是 0。
caveats.en: null means unknown or not applicable, never zero.

caveats.zh: 每格预登记 5 个实例；5 对 5 时能分辨的分差约 0.3。
caveats.en: Five preregistered instances per cell; with 5 against 5 the resolvable difference is about 0.3.

caveats.zh: Strata 结果只适用于单机单量化（rtx3080ti、IQ3_XXS，参数来自 v0.1.42 调参）。
caveats.en: Strata results hold for one host and one quantization only (rtx3080ti, IQ3_XXS, parameters from the v0.1.42 tuning).

caveats.zh: 第三阶段只是补充（用户 2026-10-22）：gpt-6-luna xhigh（配置 28）、max（配置 29）在 Codex 上 4 个场景各格取全部有效实例（不截取前 5 个：并行调度多出的有效实例不是因分数加跑，与预登记实例效力相同，用户 2026-10-23），只给逐实例结果，不进预登记比较和 Holm 族，本工程也不拿它与其他配置比较。运行于 2026-10-23（JST 02:20–07:12），借用 ChatGPT 登录，条件与 v1 相同（同一 Codex 副本、场景冻结源、harness 补丁、搜索关闭、凭据 deny-read）；与前两阶段相隔一天，服务端模型或路由可能已有变化。
caveats.en: Phase 3 is a supplement only (user 2026-10-22): gpt-6-luna xhigh (configuration 28) and max (29) on Codex, every valid instance of each cell in the 4 scenarios (no first-5 cut: the valid instances that parallel scheduling added were not run because of scores and count the same as preregistered ones, user 2026-10-23), per-instance results only, never in a preregistered comparison or the Holm family, and not compared with other configurations by this project. Run on 2026-10-23 (JST 02:20-07:12) on a borrowed ChatGPT login under the v1 conditions (same Codex copy, frozen scenario sources, harness patches, search off, credential deny-read); a day after the first two phases, so the served model or routing may have changed.
